rows.label: Personal income tax (személyi jövedelemadó, SZJA) [national]
rows.value: Flat 15% on the consolidated tax base; tax base allowances for families, first marriages, under-25s and mothers. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Hungarian-source income. 1995. évi CXVII. törvény § 8.

rows.value: 15% on the gain on securities (sale price less purchase cost and related costs). Paid by individuals (withheld by the payer where there is one). 1995. évi CXVII. törvény §§ 8 and 67.
rows.note: Checklist item A5

source.title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról (Personal Income Tax Act), version in force from 1 October 2026, §§ 8 and 67

rows.value: Pay for work done in Hungary is taxed at the flat 15% rate, withheld by the employer; tax base allowances only where at least 75% of total income is taxable in Hungary; residence test: citizenship, 183 days for EEA nationals, permanent home or centre of vital interests. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). 1995. évi CXVII. törvény §§ 1/A, 3 and 8.

rows.value: 15% on the gain on securities (sale price less purchase cost and related costs). Paid by individuals (withheld by the payer where there is one). 1995. évi CXVII. törvény §§ 8 and 67.

rows.value: Pay for work done in Hungary is taxed at the flat 15% rate, withheld by the employer; tax base allowances only where at least 75% of total income is taxable in Hungary; residence test: citizenship, 183 days for EEA nationals, permanent home or centre of vital interests. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). 1995. évi CXVII. törvény §§ 1/A, 3 and 8.

rows.label: Rental income (bérbeadásból származó jövedelem) [national]
rows.value: Income from independent activity in the combined tax base, taxed at 15% with quarterly advances; costs deducted either as a flat 10% (tax on 90% of the revenue) or itemised with invoices. Paid by landlords. 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról (NAV guidance).

rows.source_title: NAV: Élethelyzetek adózása – Nyugdíj melletti munkavállalás (dated 3 August 2024)
rows.label: Pension income: tax-free (nyugdíj) [national]
rows.value: None: pensions, disability and rehabilitation benefits, the pre-retirement benefit and the service allowance count as pensions, a tax-exempt benefit; no return is needed for them. Paid by no one. 1995. évi CXVII. törvény a személyi jövedelemadóról (NAV guidance).

rows.label: Occupational pension or private pension fund: none compulsory (magánnyugdíjpénztár) [national]
rows.value: None: membership of a private pension fund is by the individual's voluntary decision. Paid by no one. 1997. évi LXXXII. törvény, § 3.

rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 1996. évi LXXXI. törvény a társasági adóról és az osztalékadóról (Corporate Tax Act), version in force from 1 October 2026, §§ 14 and 19
rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits: no separate branch profits tax [national]
rows.value: None separately: a foreign company determines the corporate tax base of each Hungarian branch on its own, as if the branch were independent, and pays the 9% corporate tax on it. Paid by no one. 1996. évi LXXXI. törvény, §§ 14 and 19.

rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: no sales or consumption tax is among the local taxes; a settlement tax may only be set on an object not covered by a statutory public charge. Paid by no one. 1990. évi C. törvény a helyi adókról, §§ 1, 1/A and 2.

rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2012. évi LVI. törvény a távközlési adóról (Telecommunications Tax Act), version in force from 15 March 2014, § 5
rows.label: Telecommunications tax (távközlési adó) [national]
rows.value: HUF 2 per started minute of calls and HUF 2 per message from private subscribers' numbers, HUF 3 from other numbers; at most HUF 700 a month per private number and HUF 5,000 per other number. Paid by telecommunications service providers. 2012. évi LVI. törvény a távközlési adóról, § 5.

rows.source_title: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár: 2020. évi XLV. törvény a kiskereskedelmi adóról (Retail Tax Act), version in force from 31 July 2026, § 6
rows.label: Retail sales tax on retailers' turnover (kiskereskedelmi adó) [national]
rows.value: Tax years starting in 2025 and 2026: 0% up to HUF 1 billion of turnover, 0.15% up to HUF 50 billion, 1% up to HUF 150 billion and 4.5% above; motor fuel retail 0% up to HUF 500 million and 3% above. Paid by retailers. 2020. évi XLV. törvény a kiskereskedelmi adóról, § 6.

rows.label: Environmental product fee (környezetvédelmi termékdíj) [national]
rows.value: Lubricating oil HUF 114 per kg; plastic artificial flowers HUF 1,900 per kg; plastic carrier bags HUF 1,900 per kg less the extended producer responsibility fee (biodegradable bags HUF 500 less that fee); soaps, surfactants and detergents HUF 11 per kg; cosmetics HUF 57 per kg. Paid by those placing the products on the domestic market or using them for their own purposes. 2011. évi LXXXV. törvény a környezetvédelmi termékdíjról, § 1 and annex 2.

rows.label: Air passenger tax: none since 2025 (légitársaságok hozzájárulása) [national]
rows.value: None: the airline contribution (per-passenger levy on departures) was repealed from 1 January 2025; obligations arising before then follow the rules in force on 31 December 2024. Paid by no one. 2024. évi LV. törvény, § 92.

rows.label: Administrative fees: procedural duties (eljárási illeték) [national]
rows.value: General procedural duty HUF 3,000 for an administrative authority procedure; appeal against an order HUF 3,000; company register extract HUF 5,000, company certificate HUF 3,000, company copy HUF 7,000. Paid by applicants. 1990. évi XCIII. törvény az illetékekről, §§ 1 and 29.

rows.label: Municipal communal fees and taxes: communal tax of private individuals (magánszemélyek kommunális adója) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality: at most HUF 17,000 a year per building, plot or flat lease, the cap indexed by the consumer price index. Paid by owners of buildings and plots and tenants of flats not owned by individuals. 1990. évi C. törvény a helyi adókról, §§ 6, 24 and 26.
